title: Penumbra
description: Raymarch a sphere on a floor and give it a soft shadow. The canvas runs from -1 to 1. Camera: ro = (0, 3.2, 4), looking at (0, 0.3, 0). Use ww = normalize(target - ro), uu = normalize(cross(ww, vec3(0, 1, 0))), vv = cross(uu, ww), and rd = normalize(uv.x * uu + uv.y * vv + 2.0 * ww). March up to 64 steps with t += d, hit when d < 0.001, give up when t > 40. The scene is the closer of a sphere (centre (-0.3, 0.6, 0), radius 0.6) and the floor, whose distance is p.y. Take the normal from central differences with eps 0.001. Light direction l = normalize(vec3(1.8, 2.2, 0.4)), diffuse = max(dot(n, l), 0.0). For the shadow, start at p + n * 0.01 and set res = 1.0, t = 0.02. Loop up to 32 times: h = the scene distance at start + l * t, res = min(res, 8.0 * h / t), t += clamp(h, 0.02, 0.4), and stop if res < 0.001 or t > 10. The shadow is clamp(res, 0.0, 1.0). The colour is albedo * (0.15 + 0.85 * diffuse * shadow). The albedo is yellow (0.95, 0.75, 0.20) where the sphere is closer than the floor, otherwise blue-grey (0.55, 0.62, 0.75). A miss is (0.10, 0.12, 0.20).
